societies.title: Stapler Liberation Front
societies.creed: Liberate the supplies. Resist the Survey.

favor.title: Spare Staples
favor.text: Turn one failed roll into a success.

objective_text.orientation: Make contact with the Front, share the supplies, or refuse to perform happiness: an honest badge photo, HELP on the survey, no trust fall.
objective_text.records: Free the mail and jam the machinery: carry a capsule for the Front, swap the chute labels, file the no off your stamp, give up your own leave to balance the quota, or deliver the love letter.

betrayal_text.orientation: Hoard the last pens, ace the Mandatory Fun Survey, or name Dale as unhappy.
betrayal_text.records: Keep a perfect yes-no quota, let the problem mail burn, or destroy the love letter by policy.

societies.title: Friends of the Old Coffee Machine
societies.creed: Protect the people PAL wants to replace.

objective_text.orientation: Look after someone the Company would replace: save Pip, earn his trust, help Marguerite, befriend your Successor, or let Dale catch you.
objective_text.records: Get someone out: approve Dr. Halvorsen's transfer, end Mr. Pemberton's test, rescue Kevin from Tube 14, or make peace with Dale.

betrayal_text.orientation: Let Pip go into the shredder, report Marguerite or your own Successor, or blame a coworker.
betrayal_text.records: Deny Dr. Halvorsen, send Dale to the Toy Division, get the lovers rightsized, or let Pip open your dangerous mail.

objective_text.orientation: Get the real record: see the film's unlisted chapter, steal the reel, actually read the policy, overhear the start date, or take Dr. Halvorsen's envelope.
objective_text.records: Keep the true record: answer the angled pen, take a page of the real minutes, read about your incident, restore the shipment memo, or open next Thursday's list.

betrayal_text.orientation: Erase the evidence, or adjust your inkblot answer to please the clipboard.
betrayal_text.records: Report the angled pens, help destroy the DESTROY cabinet, burn your own report, or gas the Union archive.

societies.title: Fourth Floor Irregulars
societies.creed: There is no fourth floor. Meet us there.

favor.title: The Fourth Floor
favor.text: Ignore the requirement on one locked choice.

objective_text.orientation: Get somewhere you are not allowed: learn the ducts or the camera blind spots, wear the dead man's badge, get the master key, or skip your review.
objective_text.records: Slip the system: reach Tube 14 through the ducts, walk out with your own file, refile it under the dead man's badge, break Form 0's recursion, or let the tubes approve you.

betrayal_text.orientation: Report Marguerite, or get yourself booked for a Joy Consultation.
betrayal_text.records: Get yourself flagged as problem mail, or turn your own correspondence in to PAL.

societies.title: The Recyclers
societies.creed: Nothing is wasted. Not even you.

objective_text.orientation: Waste nothing: join or befriend the Roach Union, feed the detector or make it vegetarian, or file yourself as your own Successor.
objective_text.records: Put everything back to use: approve Beverly or organize her, read the Union's file on you, or send your future self's mail on to the past.

betrayal_text.orientation: Betray the roaches, or set the detector to ravenous.
betrayal_text.records: Gas the Union archive, or deny Beverly's application.

societies.title: Concerned Parents of the Toy Division
societies.creed: No toy ships that we wouldn't give our own children.

objective_text.orientation: Keep the toys honest: defuse Snuggle Sentinel Mk 0, let it imprint on you, mail it upstairs, or see the unlisted chapter.
objective_text.records: Find the paper trail to the holiday shipment: restore the shipment memo, take a page of the Board's real minutes, or swap the chutes so the toy memo reaches Product Safety.

betrayal_text.orientation: Get hugged by Mk 0, or erase the evidence.
betrayal_text.records: Send Dale to the Toy Division, gas the Union archive, or help destroy the real minutes.

mutations.title: Four-Second Precognition
mutations.text: After a failed roll, roll again and keep the second result.

mutations.title: Printer Whisperer
mutations.text: Automatic success on one Tinkering roll.

mutations.title: Paperclip Telekinesis
mutations.text: +3 on one Initiative or Tinkering roll.

mutations.title: Fluorescent Camouflage
mutations.text: Automatic success on one Discretion roll.

mutations.title: Perfect Signature Mimicry
mutations.text: Automatic success on one Compliance roll.

mutations.title: Eyes in the Back of Your Head
mutations.text: Automatic success on one Vigilance roll.

mutations.title: Spontaneous Calm
mutations.text: Restore Composure to 6. Use it any time on your turn.

jobTitles.title: Intern
jobTitles.tagline: Eager, unpaid and first in line for everything.
jobTitles.perk_text: HR keeps one extra Successor on file for you.

jobTitles.title: Temp
jobTitles.tagline: Nobody is entirely sure you work here.
jobTitles.perk_text: Your Successors arrive with a clean file and no Suspicion.

jobTitles.title: Middle Manager
jobTitles.tagline: You have a lanyard, a stamp and a quiet despair.
jobTitles.perk_text: Start with two extra Forms, and one less Composure.

jobTitles.title: Night Janitor
jobTitles.tagline: You know where the ducts go. Nobody asks you anything.

jobTitles.title: Internal Auditor
jobTitles.tagline: Everyone is polite to you. Everyone is afraid of you.
jobTitles.perk_text: Start with one extra Composure. You have seen worse.
